tools.name: estimate_credit_cost
tools.description: Estimate the credit cost of generating with a specific model, optionally for a batch of several generations.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Start generating an AI video on the authenticated account. Returns a job id immediately — poll get_generation until status is 'completed'. Charges credits only on success. Call estimate_credit_cost first if the cost matters. REQUIRES AN API KEY: add "Authorization: Bearer acd_live_…" to this MCP server; a key is created by a signed-in human at https://aicontentdrop.com/settings/integrations.

prompt.description: What the video should show. Detailed prompts produce better results.

model.description: Model ID from list_models, e.g. "kling_3_0". Omitted means the platform picks a suitable one.

image_url.description: Optional public image URL to animate (image-to-video).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Credit balance and plan for the authenticated account. Check this before a batch of generations. REQUIRES AN API KEY: add "Authorization: Bearer acd_live_…" to this MCP server; a key is created by a signed-in human at https://aicontentdrop.com/settings/integrations.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch the full text of one published article as markdown, by slug.

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Check one generation by id: status ('generating', 'completed', 'failed'), the finished video URL, and credits charged. REQUIRES AN API KEY: add "Authorization: Bearer acd_live_…" to this MCP server; a key is created by a signed-in human at https://aicontentdrop.com/settings/integrations.

tools.name: inspect_image_c2pa
tools.description: Fetch a single image (by CSS selector or URL) and return its fully decoded C2PA manifest store: every manifest's claim, assertions (e.g. c2pa.actions edit history, schema.org authorship), and the COSE signature details (algorithm and signing-certificate identity). Provide exactly one of `selector` or `url`. Note: the signature is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

selector.description: CSS selector for an element on the page.

url.description: Image URL (absolute, or relative to the current page) to fetch and inspect.

tools.name: list_generations
tools.description: List recent generations on the authenticated account, newest first. REQUIRES AN API KEY: add "Authorization: Bearer acd_live_…" to this MCP server; a key is created by a signed-in human at https://aicontentdrop.com/settings/integrations.

limit.description: How many to return (1-50). Defaults to 10.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the AI video or image models available on AI Content Drop with their flat credit cost per generation.

type.description: Model family to list. Defaults to video.

max_credits.description: Only return models costing this many credits or fewer.

tools.name: scan_images_c2pa
tools.description: Scan every on the current page for C2PA Content Credentials (content provenance metadata) and return a per-image summary: whether a manifest is present, the claim generator (the tool that produced or edited the image), the title, and the signer name. Use this to find which images on a page carry provenance data. Note: provenance is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

limit.description: Maximum number of images to fetch and scan (default 25, max 100).

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search AI Content Drop's published guides and model comparisons about AI video generation, prompting, and ad creative.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'kling vs sora' or 'ugc hooks'.
